zh.text: @TheTranscript_ 引述 D.R. Horton 執行長表示，第四季房屋市場環境更具挑戰，按揭利率上升、負擔能力受限以及消費者情緒謹慎，持續壓抑新屋需求。$DHI 盤前下跌 1%。附上圖片。

en.text: @TheTranscript_ quotes the D.R. Horton CEO saying housing market conditions became more challenging in the fourth quarter as rising mortgage rates, affordability constraints and cautious consumer sentiment kept pressuring new home demand. $DHI is down 1% pre-market. An image is attached.

zh.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies 行政總裁表示，經濟對許多客戶來說很艱難，燃油價格高企且通脹在損益中頑固偏高。客流量和銷量低於所需水平，整體表現未能反映資產質素或團隊能力，對結果和當前軌跡不滿意。

en.text: $ACI Albertsons Companies CEO stated the economy is tough for many customers with elevated fuel prices and stubbornly high inflation in P&L. Traffic and units below needed levels, overall performance does not reflect asset quality or team capabilities, not satisfied with results and current trajectory.

zh.text: 關於 $LINC / $UTI 論點中確實正在實現的一點：我們很快都會失業，並需要學習真正的技藝。

en.text: One thing about the $LINC / $UTI thesis that's definitely working out: we'll all be unemployed soon and we'll need to learn real trades.

zh.text: 美國股市盤前大幅下跌（標普500指數 -1.0%，納斯達克100指數 -2.2%），因 $INTC 與 $AMZN 業績及指引疲弱，加速科技股資金外流，成長放緩。$INTC 因個人電腦需求展望疲軟（預計持續至2027年中）暴跌25%；$AMZN 整體營收低於預期，儘管AWS表現優異且資本支出高於預期。科技同業大幅下跌：$NVDA -2.9%、$AVGO -4.0%、$MU -5.2%、$DELL -10%。布倫特原油上漲1.6%至每桶117美元。10年期國債收益率跌至4.93%，投資者尋求避險。比特幣下跌1.5%至7.56萬美元，因幣安涉及北朝鮮的63億美元黑客事件。黃金與白銀下跌。標普2026年每股盈利預估仍強勁，達369美元（同比+33%），儘管科技股疲弱。我們對 $TSLA 保持謹慎。

en.text: U.S. stocks fell sharply pre-market (SPX -1.0%, NDX -2.2%) after weak $INTC and $AMZN results and guidance accelerated a rotation out of tech amid slowing growth. INTC plunged 25% on a soft PC demand outlook projected to persist through mid-2027; AMZN missed overall revenue estimates even as AWS beat and CapEx was higher than expected. Tech peers fell sharply with $NVDA -2.9%, $AVGO -4.0%, $MU -5.2%, and $DELL -10%. Brent crude rose 1.6% to $117/bbl. 10-year yield fell to 4.93% as investors sought safety. BTC dropped 1.5% to $75.6K post Binance’s $6.3B North Korea-linked hack. Gold and silver declined. S&P 2026 EPS estimates remain robust at $369 (+33% YoY) despite the weakness in tech. We remain cautious on $TSLA.

zh.text: Michael A. Gayed 指出 2008 年信用利差從緊縮到災難性在數月內發生，2020 年僅需數週。模式總是相同：緊縮、自滿，然後劇烈重新定價。$JOJO 為該情況做準備。

en.text: Michael A. Gayed notes in 2008 credit spreads went from tight to catastrophic in months, in 2020 in weeks. Pattern always the same: tight, complacent, then violent repricing. $JOJO prepares for that.

zh.text: @APompliano 宣佈 @cfosilvia 推出以比特幣計價財富與資產的功能，認為美元貶值會扭曲財務狀況，以 $BTC 計價更能清楚反映財富增長，並附上免費試用連結。

en.text: @APompliano announces that @cfosilvia now lets users price their wealth and assets in bitcoin, arguing dollars are devalued and distort the picture of finances while denominating wealth in $BTC gives a clearer view of its growth, with a link to try it free.

zh.text: Javier Blas 關於大型石油公司第三季財報：埃克森美孚以強勁業績結束主要公司報告季。相同主題：高油氣價格，但更重要的是極高的煉油利潤率。如同競爭對手 CVX，埃克森指引投資者明年回購水平與 2026 年相似。$XOM

en.text: Javier Blas on BIG OIL 3Q EARNINGS: ExxonMobil closes the majors' reporting season with strong results. Same theme: high oil and gas prices, but above, sky-high refining margins. As rival CVX, Exxon guided investors to expect similar level of buybacks next year than in 2026. $XOM

zh.text: EliteOptionsTrader 在 $AMZN $INTC $SNDK 財報後大幅缺口下跌後概述交易計劃。中期選舉年的十月歷史上偏空。下週二中期選舉。若 $SPX 失守 7600 支撐則看 7500，$QQQ 若週一前無法收復 700 則看 685。科技與芯片股受挫：$AMD 跌 54 點，$DELL 跌 58 點，$SNDK 跌 123 點，MU 跌 59 點。建議等到中期選舉後再開始買入，不要賭 0dte。加密貨幣因幣安被盜 60 億美元而下跌。

en.text: EliteOptionsTrader outlines a trade plan after massive gap down following $AMZN $INTC $SNDK earnings. October historically bearish in midterm years. Midterm elections next Tuesday. $SPX to 7500 in play if fails to hold 7600 support, $QQQ to 685 if cannot reclaim 700 by Monday. Tech and chips crushed: $AMD down 54 points, $DELL down 58, $SNDK down 123, MU down 59. Advises waiting until after midterms to start buying and not gambling on 0dte. Crypto down after $6B stolen from Binance.

zh.text: Heisenberg 回顧自 2012 年起 $SPX 十一月首個交易日歷史：11 綠、2 紅、1 平，平均回報 +0.50%。詢問週一可能如何。

en.text: Heisenberg reviews historical first trading day of November for $SPX since 2012: 11 greens, 2 reds, 1 flat, average return +0.50%. Asks what Monday may look like.
